name: canvas-fractal-grid
title: Fractal Dot Grid
blurb: Dot grid ripples on hover combined with animated gradient background.
description: Canvas-rendered dot grid with configurable wave effects on pointer movement. Optional animated gradient background and noise overlay. Combines fractal dot animation with gradient transitions.
use_when: Complex interactive background with layered dot grid and gradient effects.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive devices or minimal animation preferences.
a11y: Decorative animation tied to mouse movement; no keyboard equivalent.
